fact_text: About 200,000 new stock market accounts were opened in FY26 in Pakistan, a sharp rise in retail participation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Building a cement plant is a large upfront capital outlay, so the return on a plant depends heavily on how much profit each ton earns over the invested capital.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cement is largely sold for cash without customer advances, so the working capital a cement business needs is low compared with many other industries.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Cement plant return on invested capital is a function of per-ton profit and plant utilisation; a plant running at high utilisation earns far more on its capital than one running at lower rates.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement was an early adopter of Chinese cement plant technology, which was cheaper per ton of capacity than European technology but less proven; other producers followed later.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: While gas was cheap, cement makers ran captive gas-based power plants, which until 2022 supplied power at roughly half the grid rate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement built 70-80 MW of captive gas-based power plants when gas was cheap, then added solar and wind capacity after gas prices rose in 2022-2023.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement has about 74 MW of solar and 29 MW of wind, and is described as the first cement company in the industry to adopt battery energy storage.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Battery storage lets solar and wind energy be saved for use at night, which raises the share of renewable power a cement plant can use and improves its efficiency.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement mostly uses imported coal from Tanzania and South Africa for its consistent quality and reliable supply; when global coal prices are normal, its imported coal costs stay competitive with local alternatives.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Limestone royalty per tonne differs by province; Punjab has the highest royalty among Pakistan's major cement provinces and Sindh the lowest.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: About 10 million tonnes of Lucky Cement's capacity is in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and about 5 million tonnes is near Karachi, both in low limestone royalty zones.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst sees Lucky Cement as a low-cost producer because of Chinese plant technology, captive power, coal sourcing and location together; these advantages are its core cost moat.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst values domestic cement capacity on a dollar-per-tonne basis, which can sit well above the actual cost of building a plant, then adjusts for asset value, net debt and profitability.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan cement plants typically produce about 60-70% of capacity in a year, while plants in Iraq and Congo run close to 100%, which the analyst says justifies a higher per-tonne valuation overseas.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement's Iraq cement plant has about 3.3 million tonnes of capacity and its Congo plant about 4 million tonnes after expansion; both are 50-50 joint ventures.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says Lucky Cement's value now depends on overseas cement, power, autos and mining, each of which must earn a high return on capital for the group's track record to continue.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Consolidated EPS of Lucky Cement can include IPP profits in which early-year debt repayment is booked as earnings, so the analyst subtracts that repayment to reach real earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Multiplying consolidated EPS by a P/E ratio overstates fair value for Lucky Cement unless the IPP's debt repayment is first removed from earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Government of Pakistan policy gives IPPs a fixed return on their investment, so installed plant cost is the most direct anchor for valuing an IPP.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Electric Power is a 660 MW coal-fired IPP that Lucky Cement owns 100%; roughly 25% of the plant cost was funded by Lucky equity and the rest by debt.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement holds about 253 million shares of Lucky Core Industries.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement also has investments in Samsung mobile phone assembly and Morinaga Pakistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Motor Corporation is 75% owned by Lucky Cement and sits in a special economic zone with an income tax exemption until 2029.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Motor Corporation launched the Chinese brand GAC in Pakistan, with two variants introduced so far.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Retail investors often buy automaker shares on car-launch hype after a stock has already risen; the analyst says this is unlikely to repeat for Lucky Cement, which is already large.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst says the auto business can add value to Lucky Cement, but because the existing businesses are already large, the share price is unlikely to re-rate as sharply as a small automaker's would.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst treats the mining stake as an option value, not part of the core thesis; fair value should improve only after a major discovery is confirmed, and mining earnings may take time.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Lucky Cement holds a 33% stake in National Resources Limited (NRL), which is exploring for copper and gold in Chagai, Balochistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: National Resources Limited received an exploration licence in 2023 for copper and gold exploration in Chagai, Balochistan.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: National Resources Limited announced significant copper and gold mineral discoveries in 2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Is Lucky Cement Overpriced or Undervalued? The Owner's Analysis' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's three-step framework is to understand the business, verify it, and only then invest.
